description: List auto-injury cases matching filters, in docket-number order, up to 50 per page. Use get_case for one case in full and stats for counts, rates and amounts across many.

case_type.description: Case type code: V01, V04 or V09.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

disposition_category.description: How the case ended, e.g. withdrawal or plaintiff_verdict; pending for open cases.

filed_from.description: Filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

filed_to.description: Filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

firm_juris_number.description: Juris number from search_firms; matches either side's lead firm.

judge_key.description: Judge key from search_judges; matches the judge who decided the disposition.

limit.description: Results per page, at most 50 (the default).

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

name: search_cases

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

caseType.description: Court case type code: V01 driver or passenger vs driver, V04 pedestrian vs driver, V09 other motor-vehicle torts.

dispositionCategory.description: How the case ended, grouped from the court disposition text; null while pending. damages_hearing is a judgment after a hearing that only set damages, usually after a default, not a trial.

dispositionDate.description: Date of disposition; null while pending.

district.description: Judicial district the case is filed in, e.g. HARTFORD JD.

litigationType.description: third_party (injured person vs at-fault driver), um_uim (claim against own uninsured/underinsured motorist carrier), subrogation (insurer suing to recover what it paid).

officialUrl.description: The case on the Connecticut Judicial Branch civil inquiry site, the official record.

trialKind.description: jury or court when the case was tried to a verdict or decision; null otherwise.

title: Search cases
